operations.name: read_ioapic_id
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov ebx, 0xFEC00000
mov dword [ebx], 0x00
mov eax, [ebx + 0x10]
ret
operations.returns: IOAPIC ID register in EAX (bits 27:24 = APIC ID)

operations.name: read_ioapic_ver
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov ebx, 0xFEC00000
mov dword [ebx], 0x01
mov eax, [ebx + 0x10]
ret
operations.returns: IOAPIC version in EAX (bits 7:0 = version, bits 23:16 = max redirection entries)
